title: EduPluginBench: Executable Assurance for AI-Generated Educational Plugins
title_zh: EduPluginBench：面向 AI 生成教育插件的可执行保障基准
abstract_en: Code-generation models can produce executable components, but compilation and functional tests do not establish compliance with least privilege, telemetry consent, provenance, privileged-write authority, lifecycle constraints, or bounded failure. We introduce EduPluginBench, an executable benchmark and staged admission method for generated plugins in governed software ecosystems. Across 1,440 activation-checked first-order mutants from 30 specifications, P0-P4 increased release-blocking-defect recall by 74.7 percentage points (specification-clustered 95% CI 73.4-75.8) over P0-P2, with no observed rejection among 120 clean references (95% Wilson upper bound 3.1%). A frozen transfer study of 600 unmodified generations from two current coding models found that 300/600 parsed, but none passed P0 or achieved P0-P4 conformance (95% upper bound 0.64%); downstream assurance estimands were undefined. An independently labelled Moodle study retained 16 vulnerable/fixed pairs; the frozen generic PHP detector found no vulnerable revisions. These negative transfer results prevent controlled contract consistency from being read as independent real-defect effectiveness. An earlier 540-generation diagnostic found that post-hoc bounded repair yielded 112 P0 passes, all nonconforming, with recall increasing from 13.4% to 100%. The artifact retains protocols, public-source provenance, raw generations, row-level decisions, audits, analysis code, and reproduction instructions.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 EduPluginBench，一个用于治理型软件生态中 AI 生成教育插件的可执行基准与分阶段准入方法。作者指出，代码生成模型产出的组件即使能够编译并通过功能测试，也不能保证其满足最小权限、遥测同意、来源可追溯、特权写入授权、生命周期约束或有界失败等治理要求。实验基于 30 个规格构造的 1,440 个激活检查一阶变异体，发现完整 P0-P4 阶段相较 P0-P2 将发布阻断缺陷召回率提高 74.7 个百分点，且在 120 个干净参考实现中未观察到误拒。对两个当前代码模型的 600 个未修改生成结果进行冻结迁移研究时，仅 300/600 可解析，但没有任何样本通过 P0 或达到 P0-P4 合规，导致下游保障估计量无法定义。独立标注的 Moodle 漏洞/修复对研究也显示，冻结通用 PHP 检测器未能发现脆弱版本。因此，受控合约一致性不能被解读为独立真实缺陷有效性。作者还报告早期 540 次生成诊断中，事后有界修复虽得到 112 个 P0 通过样本，但全部不合规；完整流程将召回率从 13.4% 提升至 100%。论文发布了协议、公开来源、原始生成、逐行决策、审计、分析代码与复现实验说明。
key_points_zh: EduPluginBench 关注 AI-generated educational plugins 的治理合规，而不仅是编译通过或功能正确。
P0-P4 分阶段准入显著提升发布阻断缺陷召回率，比 P0-P2 高 74.7 个百分点，且在干净参考实现上未观察到误拒。
对两个当前 coding models 的 600 个冻结生成样本进行迁移测试，虽有半数可解析，但无一通过 P0 或达到 P0-P4 conformance。
Moodle 漏洞/修复对实验中，通用 PHP detector 未检出脆弱版本，说明基准内合约一致性不能直接等同于真实缺陷检测能力。
论文强调可复现性，提供 protocols、raw generations、row-level decisions、audits、analysis code 和 reproduction instructions。

llm_assessment.comment: EduPluginBench offers a concrete executable assurance and admission framework for generated plugins, with durable ideas despite a narrow educational-plugin domain.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: EduPluginBench 为生成式插件提供了具体的可执行保障与准入框架，虽领域较窄但思想具有持久价值。
